note: TOWN_LIFE §3.1 (TL-A2): sitting on a stool or bench at a tea table, hands on the knees, breathing and looking around; a 3 s loop. Legs are ABSOLUTE on a STAND1 base like the jump (thigh = hip swing forward from the idle, knee = included bend, foot = + toes up, toe = toe joint bend) and stay the same on every key so the feet never slide. Arms REACH: the wrist is solved every frame to sit on the knee (from the calf's head: [forward, up, right] metres). lean = spine forward, head = nod forward (the keyer adds a gaze-keeping counter to the lean), headYaw = + looks left. The seat height is measured by the keyer (town_keys.json `seat`). Shared by both skeletons (the keyer measures each one's limbs).
